snippet.title: Disney's Frozen Free Fall: Snowball Fight Trailer | Available Now
snippet.description:
The ultimate Match-3 experience & Disney’s #1 puzzle matching game is now on console and PC. 

With Frozen Free Fall: Snowball Fight, get ready to turn your living room into an epic puzzle matching battle. Challenge your friends & family to a snowball battle, unlock and play as your favourite characters and unleash dazzling powers! 

Available to download now for free.
Free to download & play. Game contains in-app purchases. Digital downloads only, on PS3, PS4, Xbox 360, Xbox One, and Steam.
